title: Cyprus, Slovak Republic, Slovenia accede to Treaty of Amity and Cooperation
summary: Three more countries have acceded as high-contracting parties to the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation (TAC), Department of Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro announced on Saturday.
